symbol.title: Part definition
symbol.desc: Minimal sharp-corner part definition node with an editable name label. No compartments, boundary ports, aliases or additional prefixes. The host renderer supplies these when required.

symbol.title: Composite part usage
symbol.desc: Minimal solid rounded part usage node with an editable name/type label. Represents the composite example. Prefix combinations, compartments and port attachments are not included.
symbol.metadata: {"license": "Apache-2.0", "license_url": "https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0", "copyright": "Copyright 2026 Dynamical Systems Group", "source": ["https://www.omg.org/spec/SysML/2.0/Language/PDF#page=241"], "source_sha256": "46e6c0476a6f1f34f367d57e039d56659bff75e41d2e4b3d37ca4cadea84a83a", "production_ids": ["8.2.3.11/part/1", "8.2.3.11/part-name-compartment/1"], "provenance": "Original reusable redraw; not an official OMG figure or a conformance result."}

symbol.title: Referential part usage
symbol.desc: Dashed rounded referential part usage node, retaining its ref part keyword. This remains a PartUsage. The displayed multiplicity is an example, not a default or a validation result.
symbol.metadata: {"license": "Apache-2.0", "license_url": "https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0", "copyright": "Copyright 2026 Dynamical Systems Group", "source": ["https://www.omg.org/spec/SysML/2.0/Language/PDF#page=241"], "source_sha256": "46e6c0476a6f1f34f367d57e039d56659bff75e41d2e4b3d37ca4cadea84a83a", "production_ids": ["8.2.3.11/part-ref/1", "8.2.3.11/part-name-compartment/1"], "provenance": "Original reusable redraw; not an official OMG figure or a conformance result."}

symbol.title: Full port usage
symbol.desc: Minimal full port usage node with an editable name/type label. This is the full node form. Nested ports, direction glyphs and reference/proxy alternatives are omitted.
symbol.metadata: {"license": "Apache-2.0", "license_url": "https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0", "copyright": "Copyright 2026 Dynamical Systems Group", "source": ["https://www.omg.org/spec/SysML/2.0/Language/PDF#page=242", "https://www.omg.org/spec/SysML/2.0/Language/PDF#page=243"], "source_sha256": "46e6c0476a6f1f34f367d57e039d56659bff75e41d2e4b3d37ca4cadea84a83a", "production_ids": ["8.2.3.12/port-usage/1", "8.2.3.12/port-name-compartment/1"], "provenance": "Original reusable redraw; not an official OMG figure or a conformance result."}

symbol.title: Boundary port glyph
symbol.desc: Small rounded undirected boundary port glyph, supplied as a component without a label or host node. Glyph only. Place it on the appropriate boundary and supply the position-specific port label. It does not include arrows, dotted references, nested ports or proxy dots.
symbol.metadata: {"license": "Apache-2.0", "license_url": "https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0", "copyright": "Copyright 2026 Dynamical Systems Group", "source": ["https://www.omg.org/spec/SysML/2.0/Language/PDF#page=244", "https://www.omg.org/spec/SysML/2.0/Language/PDF#page=245"], "source_sha256": "46e6c0476a6f1f34f367d57e039d56659bff75e41d2e4b3d37ca4cadea84a83a", "production_ids": ["8.2.3.12/port-l/1", "8.2.3.12/port-r/1", "8.2.3.12/port-t/1", "8.2.3.12/port-b/1"], "provenance": "Original reusable redraw; not an official OMG figure or a conformance result."}

symbol.title: Full connection usage
symbol.desc: Minimal full connection usage node. No compartments or elaboration links. The host renderer determines how the modeled connection is related to its endpoints.
symbol.metadata: {"license": "Apache-2.0", "license_url": "https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0", "copyright": "Copyright 2026 Dynamical Systems Group", "source": ["https://www.omg.org/spec/SysML/2.0/Language/PDF#page=246", "https://www.omg.org/spec/SysML/2.0/Language/PDF#page=247"], "source_sha256": "46e6c0476a6f1f34f367d57e039d56659bff75e41d2e4b3d37ca4cadea84a83a", "production_ids": ["8.2.3.13/connection/1", "8.2.3.13/connection-name-compartment/1"], "provenance": "Original reusable redraw; not an official OMG figure or a conformance result."}

symbol.title: Binary connection edge
symbol.desc: Solid undirected binary connection line with an editable optional label. Attach start/end anchors to valid connection ends. Direction indication, roles, multiplicities and adornments are omitted. This line does not imply flow direction.
symbol.metadata: {"license": "Apache-2.0", "license_url": "https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0", "copyright": "Copyright 2026 Dynamical Systems Group", "source": ["https://www.omg.org/spec/SysML/2.0/Language/PDF#page=247", "https://www.omg.org/spec/SysML/2.0/Language/PDF#page=248"], "source_sha256": "46e6c0476a6f1f34f367d57e039d56659bff75e41d2e4b3d37ca4cadea84a83a", "production_ids": ["8.2.3.13/connection-graphical/1", "8.2.3.13/connection-label/1"], "provenance": "Original reusable redraw; not an official OMG figure or a conformance result."}

symbol.title: Three-ended connection
symbol.desc: Representative three-ended usage connection with a filled central dot and solid segments. A fixed layout with three endpoint anchors. The host renderer must reroute or add segments for other layouts/end counts. Role labels and multiplicities are omitted.
symbol.metadata: {"license": "Apache-2.0", "license_url": "https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0", "copyright": "Copyright 2026 Dynamical Systems Group", "source": ["https://www.omg.org/spec/SysML/2.0/Language/PDF#page=248"], "source_sha256": "46e6c0476a6f1f34f367d57e039d56659bff75e41d2e4b3d37ca4cadea84a83a", "production_ids": ["8.2.3.13/n-ary-connection/1", "8.2.3.13/n-ary-connection-dot/1", "8.2.3.13/n-ary-segment/1"], "provenance": "Original reusable redraw; not an official OMG figure or a conformance result."}

symbol.title: Binding connection
symbol.desc: Solid binding line with the required equals sign. Endpoint usage nodes must have compatible types. The equals sign is fixed; the component does not validate endpoint compatibility.
